COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1543 of 2022
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Mukesh Singh Rawat, Advocate 
for the petitioner.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for 
respondent nos. 1 to 4.
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties.
On the oral prayer made by learned 
counsel for the petitioner, he is 
permitted to implead ‘Principal Controller 
of Defence Accounts (Pensions), 
Prayagraj’, as respondent no. 5.
Amended memo of parties be 
supplied in the Registry on or before 
18.08.2022.
Newly impleaded respondent shall 
be served through office of Assistant 
Solicitor General.
As prayed, four weeks’ time is 
granted to learned counsel for 
respondent nos. 1 to 4 to file counter 
affidavit.
Newly impleaded respondent may 
file counter affidavit within the same  time. 
Petitioner shall supply copy of this 
order in the office of Assistant Solicitor 
General, within 48 hours.
List this matter on 30.09.2022.
Till the next date of listing, no 
further recovery shall be made from the 
pension account of the petitioner. 
Interim relief application (I.A. No. 1 
of 2022) stands disposed of. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 05.08.2022
Arpan

Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. M.S. Rawat, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Akshay Latwal, Advocate holding 
brief of Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for the 
respondent nos. 1 to 4.
The respondent nos. 1 to 4 seeks 
permission to file counter affidavit. 
Last opportunity was given on the last 
occasion, so that within the stipulated time, the 
counter affidavit be filed.
Counter affidavit is filed, but it is delayed.
Let it be taken on record. IA No. 2 of 2023 
stands disposed of accordingly.
Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks 
time to file rejoinder affidavit.
Let it be filed within four weeks.
List on 19.10.2023.
Interim order, if any, stands disposed of 
accordingly.
